description: The provided image is a donut chart, a variation of a pie chart, representing the distribution of a category identified by the bolded text "Task Type" located in the center of the ring. The chart consists of a total of two slices. The significantly larger slice, colored in a dark reddish-brown, is labeled "Article generation" and accounts for 83.2% of the total. The smaller slice, colored in olive green, is labeled "Headline generation" and represents the remaining 16.8%. The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, the category labels and their corresponding percentages enclosed in parentheses are positioned directly outside their respective segments. Neither of the slices is visually emphasized through exploding or offsetting, and the segments are visually ordered with the larger proportion dominating the left and top portions of the ring.
